sections.title: Result
sections.text: S1–S9 static shipped-schema gate, 22-set actual Testbench manifest, finite integer allowlist and initial 18-package pending inventory; existing anti-weakening ratchet now protects both inventories. Ownership gate delegates registered paths to S9, preserving T4. PG tenant/central/dedicated and SQLite supported tenant Golden catalogues plus opt-in snapshots and hermetic CI wiring.

sections.title: Owner-approved scope and validation
sections.text: Owner 2026-10-06 requested only affected checks, no unchanged package suites, one final review over all work. Owner explicitly approved minimal connection-source repairs and necessary principled related changes. Three operations/webhooks up() methods now use Schema::getConnection(), unchanged DDL. Two retention fixtures now use SchemaMigrator. The pre-existing crm_sources table is added to the ownership inventory. Package changelogs record the connection ownership change. Physical tenancy remains PG-only; SQLite supported sets use the existing CRM account fixture, declared transparently as a host prerequisite.

sections.title: Intentional Golden update
sections.text: GOLDEN_UPDATE=1 class: initial pre-baseline schema catalogues. No DDL squash or data conversion. Projection includes ordered column maps, type/null/default, named indexes and predicates/methods, named FKs/actions/deferral, named CHECK expressions, triggers and enum_types, without OID/ACL/physical identity. Actual budget snapshot export byte-structure equals dedicated.pgsql.json. Later baseline updates belong to P08.4–P08.8. Review correction updates the initial SQLite projection to stored autoindex names. Four pre-existing >63-byte stored names remain temporarily allowed only while their owning package is pending; exact observed keys are ratcheted and must be removed with baseline normalization. No new long names can be rebaselined.
